# Synthetic PDF fixtures

The PDF fixture set is intentionally synthetic and must contain no real financial information. Generate local fixtures with a PDF tool before running the integration suite:

- `standard_table.pdf`
- `multi_page_table.pdf`
- `debit_credit_columns.pdf`
- `amount_balance_ambiguous.pdf`
- `repeated_headers.pdf`
- `missing_values.pdf`
- `duplicate_rows.pdf`
- `scanned_style.pdf`
- `invalid_rows.pdf`
- `opening_closing_balances.pdf`

The current environment does not have Python available, so binary fixtures have not been generated or executed here.
